relations.statement: InFourierDitaChart implies existence of a mutually unbiased triple within any seven-basis family in the Chart

lemmas.statement: The premise FourierTripleLandingPremise combined with InFourierDitaChart implies NoCompleteMUB6
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem L1 (h_landing : FourierTripleLandingPremise) (h_chart : InFourierDitaChart) : NoCompleteMUB6 := by
  exact no_complete_mub6_of_fourier_triple_landing h_landing
  exact no_complete_mub6_via_route_c (MUB6.RouteC.route_c_complete_mub_family_impossible _ _)

near_misses.claim: Assuming a landing map CompleteMUB6 → RouteCCompleteMUBFamily directly yields a contradiction without the Fourier triple premise
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The landing map requires a pre-existing Fourier triple to trigger the NoCompleteMUB6 conclusion; the route C impossibility is not automatically implied by the landing condition alone.
